analyst_view.overall: Angers are 15th, only one point above the relegation zone, and have won once since September. They have not taken a point off a top-half side this season. Nice are eighth and in form, with four wins in their last five league games, including a 5-2 win over Rennes. Angers are without striker Amine El Ouazzani, and one preview says Oumar Pona is also likely out. For Nice, Axel Witsel is a doubt.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. Nice have scored 12 in their last six, and Angers have conceded nine at home and five from set pieces, tied for the second-most in the league. Nice, led by top scorer Elye Wahi, look able to score enough on their own to push this game higher than the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Nice dominate possession and should pin Angers back, but the model already allows for that, so we stay close to it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. Geoffrey Kubler is the referee, and there are no suspensions or disciplinary issues in the news, so we keep the model's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.8 shots. Nice's possession game should push their share up, and losing El Ouazzani takes something away from Angers, so the total probably lands near the model's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. Nice are creating good chances (13 goals in their last six games across all competitions) against an Angers defence that has struggled at home, so we lean slightly higher.
